svg.title: 3.1.2 Proposed System Architecture
svg.desc: Verified architecture of the implemented honeypot system, showing the real-time data path and the separate human-gated offline model lifecycle.
svg.text: Implemented multi-service honeypot, hybrid IDS, analyst operations, and human-gated model updates
later stores IDS, feedback, IPS audit
